record.title: Here From the Start
record.description:
One day, wallflower Kim Hyejin wakes up as her web novel counterpart, Maria, a maid who is ignored by...well, everyone. No one ever really notices her, as if she was a ghost, but Grand Duke Dietrich can't seem to take his eyes off her. Seeing his rival's interest in the girl, Prince Elias resolves to use her for his own advantage in the battle for the throne. As misunderstandings and mystery surrounding Maria grow, she's quickly going from invisible to intriguing to...potentially irresistible!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/58345016), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1811236703), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11308024), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/been_here), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/always_here_first), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000064718), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/F_the_beginning?p_id=pp_1601_001)

record.title: Palace Slave
record.description:
As a child, Seori is nearly sold into a courtesan house by her mother, but is saved by the benevolent Queen Yeonhwa. So she later helps the queen's son, Prince Seon-gyeom, avoid an attempt on his life and run away from the kingdom. Six years later, Seori is living in disguise as a "male" slave at the palace for her safety. But then, Seon-gyeom unexpectedly returns as a powerful prince and is drawn to Seori despite failing to recognize her. Can Seori keep her identity a secret with the prince's heated obsession growing by the day?

**Original Novel:**    
[R19](https://www.millie.co.kr/v4/book/82d30dd2321b4083), [R15](https://www.millie.co.kr/v4/book/42f9309b670d46e7)

record.title: Servant Beasts
record.description:
From Yen Press:

Deceived and then put up for sale at a black-market auction, therianthrope Hal is bought by the sinister and widely feared Bone Witch. Hal, forced to become the witch's familiar, is ordered to do everything from housework to shady dealings—such is his plight. However, as the two spend more time together, Hal's earnest and amiable nature gradually begins to thaw the witch's icy heart. Hal is touched by the witch's clumsy kindness, and a familiar's loyalty begins to sprout in him…

record.title: After Service
record.description:
Hardcore After a Hard Day’s Work!

Working nine to five is a full schedule for most people, but the experienced working women these guys run into in this collection are nowhere near ready for an after-hours special service! As full-figured women with bodies packed with a lot of oomph, they put their whole body into their jobs and give their partners a feel for the weight and softness to earn that extra tip. After savoring the finest goods, there's an all-night service they'll continue to relish until the break of dawn!
